in_sanskrit.name: चन्द्रचूर्
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who absorbs or drinks the moon's essence
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: चन्द्र (Chandra) - moon चूर् (Chur) - to drink or absorb Therefore, Chandrachur means 'one who absorbs or drinks the moon's essence'

in_hindi.name: चन्द्रचूर्
in_hindi.meaning: व्यक्ति जो चंद्र के रस पीता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: चन्द्र (Chandra) - moon चूर् (Chur) - पीना (to drink) Therefore, Chandrachur means 'a person who drinks the essence of the moon'

in_tamil.name: சந்திரசுர்
in_tamil.meaning: ஓர் அவ்விடம் ஸூரிய விழியில் இறக்கிக்கோப்பிட்ட ஒரு மனிதன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: சந்திர (Chandra) - ஸூரியம் சுர் (Chur) - இறக்கிக்கோப் (to drink) Therefore, Chandrachur means 'a person who drinks the essence of the sun'

in_telugu.name: చంద్రచూర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: చంద్ర (Chandra) - చూర్ణముదేశము చూర్ (Chur) - పోయిపోయిన్యే (to drink) Therefore, Chandrachur means 'a person who has absorbed the essence of the moon'

in_marathi.name: Chandrachur
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon God's Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandrachur हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandrachur is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Chandra' meaning moon and 'Chur' meaning power. This name is attributed to the Hindu deity Siva, who is often depicted holding a crescent moon on his forehead. Chandrachur represents the divine power and blessings of the moon god.

in_bengali.name: Chandrachur
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Moon God's Power
in_bengali.long_meaning: Chandrachur একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Chandrachur is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Chandra' meaning moon and 'Chur' meaning power. This name is attributed to the Hindu deity Siva, who is often depicted holding a crescent moon on his forehead. Chandrachur represents the divine power and blessings of the moon god.
